0022600157.text: The Toronto Raptors (3-2, fifth in the East and third in the Atlantic, 2 games back) visit the Los Angeles Lakers (4-2, first in the Pacific), with Toronto coming off a loss and holding a 1-1 road record this season. Toronto is without Jakob Poeltl (shoulder inflammation), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), while the Lakers are missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Ziaire Williams (foot). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their last meeting was a 110-93 Lakers win in Los Angeles on January 18, 2026, part of a 2025-26 season series in which Toronto lost both games.
